messages:
marie.w: heads up — noticed a sudden drop in prefix cache hit-rate on gpu-pool-prod-3 after yesterday's kernel-selector rollout. p99 up and eviction rate spiked.

aj: what are the numbers?

marie.w: short summary: hit-rate went 0.81 -> 0.58 over ~3h, p99 gen latency +35%. eviction count doubled. memory frag ratio climbed. kernel selector flipped many workloads from the int8 path to a fp16 kernel because the seq_len histogram shifted. fp16 path uses slightly bigger KV buffers and seems to worsen fragmentation.

samir.k: did anything else change that could cause key churn or cold misses?

marie.w: yes — found a config roll (deploy-202) that introduced a new env "prefix_hash_salt" for tokenizer normalization. it changed the KV keyspace; combined with kernel memory increase we got a miss + warmup storm while compaction was paused.

zhen: so two interacting failures: kernel path increased resident memory and allocation churn, AND the salt caused previously-warm keys to miss, forcing many new inserts. OOM pressure triggered aggressive LRU eviction which kept evictions cycling.

aj: immediate mitigations we can do now? revert salt? force kernel fallback?

marie.w: starting a 10% rollback of the salt change now. also issuing a hotfix to kernel-selector to prefer int8 on the affected GPUs:

pctl set kernel_selector.policy=prefer_int8 --scope=gpu-pool-prod-3 --tag emergency_202

samir.k: longer term we should add a warmup policy to reduce churn: when a new key appears and then is re-used within X minutes, treat it as warm and give it a boosted soft-ttl. that reduces immediate eviction pressure.

zhen: here's a suggested minimal config to try quickly: 

```
kv_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 3600
  warmup_multiplier: 3    # multiply ttl during warmup window
  warmup_window_seconds: 600
  soft_cap_ratio: 0.7
  compact_every: 120      # background compaction frequency (s)
```

marie.w: ran a profiler before/after the rollback+warmup change:

pctl profile --gpu 3 --window 600 --tag eviction_heatmap_v2
=> frag_ratio: 0.28 (peak) before; after compact and int8 fallback frag_ratio dropped to 0.12
=> hit_rate: 0.58 -> 0.79 after rollback + warmup_multiplier rollout to 50%

aj: nice. can we backfill keys so clients that got salted keys still hit the cache? that would speed recovery.

samir.k: we can run a backfill job that scans recent prompts from s3 and re-inserts normalized keys mapping old_salt->new into cache with low ttl. implementation caveat: bulk inserts will spike allocations; must rate-limit.

eviction-bot: auto-compaction scheduled: compact/gpu3 started in 120s; will post logs.

zhen: operational next steps: 1) finish salt rollback (done 60% so far), 2) enable warmup_multiplier cluster-wide with conservative multiplier, 3) schedule background compaction on all pools, 4) add guard in kernel-selector to avoid switching to heavier-memory kernels if free_mem_delta > 10% in last 5m, 5) implement backfill with rate limit.

marie.w: i'll open a quick RFC with metrics and a postmortem draft. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

aj: :thumbsup:
